hypotheses.statement: The observed memory/exhaustion program difference is driven primarily by immune-cell composition across lesions.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: After cell-type-aware aggregation, the lesion-level program difference will substantially attenuate.

hypotheses.statement: The observed program difference persists within matched immune cell states and reflects a cell-state shift.
hypotheses.falsifiable_prediction: Within a prespecified immune cell type, the program difference will retain its direction after lesion-aware analysis.

discriminating_experiment.intervention: Cell-type-aware pseudo-bulk reanalysis of the frozen primary cohort
discriminating_experiment.comparator: All-CD45 lesion pseudo-bulk versus within-cell-type lesion pseudo-bulk
discriminating_experiment.readout: Direction and magnitude of pre-registered memory and exhaustion program scores
discriminating_experiment.prediction_if_hypothesis_a: Program separation attenuates after composition-aware aggregation.
discriminating_experiment.prediction_if_hypothesis_b: Program separation remains directionally concordant within at least one prespecified immune cell type.
